releaseCandidate.warning: A source baseline and an active root build are not installed release candidates.

requiredCandidateIdentity: fork commit and complete integrated patch-series identity
per-OS package SHA-256, architecture, signing/notarization state and install route
effective GN args identity with secrets excluded
OS release and Linux display backend when applicable
native binary identity and runtime fixture versions
feature flags, optional components and authorized hardware/service availability

variantDefinitions.baseline: Ordinary native launch under Profile A with distinct test fixtures. Pointer and keyboard entry and accessible focus observations.
variantDefinitions.competing-profile: Another native window and another Profile exist and are active most recently. Same-host A/B Space switching is a separate required gate, not simulated by separate windows.
variantDefinitions.pending-context-change: Start action on A, switch to B before completion, then cancel or complete. Include requester document/host closure where the fixture supports it; absence of a safe route stays OPEN.
variantDefinitions.approved-handoff: After the production saved-page handoff is proven, repeat with the same live page transferred to its actual destination host. Never use Model::OpenItem as the handoff.
variantDefinitions.private-where-supported: Record supported OTR/regular behavior using the existing private/download classifiers. A route unavailable in private mode is explicitly unavailable with evidence, never silently omitted.

requiredObservationFields: requesting PageId/document, exact Profile/OTR state, Space and native host
selected workspace object separately from active page surface
actual recipient page/Profile/native host and accessible focus
prompt, cancel, failure and stale-completion outcome
test command or authorized native steps and result
redacted screenshots/logs or native test output
unsupported reason and authority if unavailable

stateRules.OPEN: Unexecuted or missing required target/variant/identity; cannot close acceptance.
stateRules.PASS: Observed native result on the exact declared RC with required evidence and variants.
stateRules.FAIL: Observed mismatch, with separately filed defect and reproducer.
stateRules.UNAVAILABLE: Evidence identifies a platform/build/hardware/permission absence. This is not a pass or an approved waiver.
